items.q: What did Moonshot release as Kimi K3.1?
items.a: A **3-trillion-parameter open-weight model** at frontier level.

items.q: How did Kimi K3.1 do on independent tests?
items.a: Artificial Analysis measured **67% on Terminal Bench**, the **highest** of any model it tested.

items.q: Why should agent benchmark scores be read with care?
items.a: **Harness differences** can produce **huge swings** in results.
Using **swarms of fake users** to harvest a model's outputs to **train another model**.

items.q: Why did Moonshot remove cybersecurity data?
items.a: To **weaken hacking ability** (90.5% → 81% on exploit tests) amid **US bans** on Chinese models.

items.q: Why did Kimi's 3D horse lose to Claude's?
items.a: It **warped the mesh** instead of animating a **bone skeleton**.
Check **how** a model solved a task, not just **how good it looks**.
